transcriptionPolicy: Reading transcription of the text printed in Gastaldi’s 1684 edition. Long s is rendered as s; line-end divisions are joined; typographic spacing and apostrophes are regularized. Historical spelling and abbreviations are retained. Uncertain readings and substantive editorial choices are identified in the notes. OCR was used as a reading aid and compared against page images.
paragraphPolicy: Paired passages follow printed paragraphs where practicable. The heading, dateline and signatures are separated for citation; paragraph identifiers and English descriptive labels are editorial. Source page arrays include every page crossed by a passage.

segments.label: Exception for specified provisions
segments.original: Con li Bandi Generali, & altre prouisionali si è prohibito l’introdurre nello Stato Ecclesiastico Animali, & ogni sorte di Mercantie, che venissero da luogo sospetto di mal Contagioso, ò l’hauessero tocco per strada. Per euitare, in quanto sia possibile, le difficoltà impedienti la communicatione delle robbe non soggette à Contagio, in riguardo del publico seruitio, con il presente Editto d’ordine espresso di Nostro Signore si dichiara, che sarà in libertà di ciascuno il portar nello Stato Ecclesiastico, così per Mare, come per Terra, Grasce d’Animali viuenti, Vini di qualsiuoglia sorte, Droghe, & altre merci incapaci di Contagio, purche le Persone, che condurranno, habbiano seco le giustificationi della buona salute loro, de’ luoghi, d’onde sono partiti, e per li quali sono passati.
segments.english: The general proclamations and other provisional orders have prohibited the introduction into the Papal State of animals and every kind of merchandise coming from a place suspected of contagious disease or having touched one on the way. To avoid, as far as possible and for the public service, difficulties obstructing the circulation of goods not subject to contagion, this edict, by the express command of Our Lord, declares that everyone shall be free to bring into the Papal State, by sea or land, provisions consisting of live animals, wines of every kind, spices and other merchandise regarded as incapable of carrying contagion, provided that the persons conveying them carry documentation of their own good health and that of the places from which they departed and through which they passed.

notes.text: “Incapaci di Contagio” states the historical classification of the goods, not a modern finding about their safety. The exception retains health-documentation conditions for carriers and their routes.
“Grasce” denotes provisions; in “Grasce d’Animali viuenti” it is connected to live animals, not an unrestricted exemption for all foodstuffs.
